newsitem.title: UK: Christie's sees first half art sales rise 64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Christie's sees first half art sales rise 64 pct.

text.p: Christie's International Plc said on Friday that its sales of Impressionist and contemporary art rose 64 percent in the first half of 1997 to $322 million.

In a statement the auctioneers said the sharp rise in first half sales over the same 1996 period was partly due to the sale of the Loeb collection of Impressionist art in May which realised $92.8 million.
Christie's said the Ganz collection in November is expected to realise $125 million, making it the most expensive single-owner collection of 20th century art to appear at auction.
